kept.excerpt: A Espanha está de volta às quartas de final da Copa do Mundo após 16 anos. A Espanha não sofre gols há seis jogos consecutivos em Copas do Mundo, superando o recorde da competição, anteriormente alcançado pela Itália (1990) e pela Suíça (entre 2006 e 2010). Por isso, Unai Simón chegou ao sexto jogo consecutivo sem sofrer gols em Copas do Mundo (desde o empate por 0 a 0 com o Marrocos, em dezembro de 2022, antes da eliminação nos pênaltis), superando o recorde de Walter Zenga, pela Itália, em 1990.
kept.relevance: FIFA's cutoff-date report establishes that Spain reached the quarter-finals and Simón extended his consecutive World Cup clean-sheet record, including the Morocco match in 2022.

kept.excerpt: España busca avanzar en esta Copa del Mundo. Los de Luis de la Fuente han completado hasta ahora un torneo impecable, dejando la portería a 0 en los 4 partidos de lo que va de Mundial, lo que da buena muestra de la solidez defensiva que ofrece el combinado nacional. El portero del Athletic de Bilbao es el titular indiscutible de la portería española durante este Mundial.
kept.relevance: This report published before the Portugal match documents Simón's established starting position and Spain's four clean sheets in their first four tournament matches.

kept.excerpt: Spain advanced to the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup 2026™ as two goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro's first for his country secured a convincing victory over Austria in Los Angeles. The clean sheet for Unai Simon was his fifth in successive matches at the World Cup (dating back to December 2022 when Spain drew 0-0 with Morocco before losing on a penalty shootout), and it equalled Walter Zenga's record for Italy in 1990.
kept.relevance: The official Austria match report confirms Spain's knockout progress and Simón's uninterrupted clean-sheet run before the cutoff-date round of 16.

kept.excerpt: Unai Simón, la apuesta firme bajo palos del seleccionador español pese al debate que se generó ya desde antes ya de empezar el torneo con David Raya y Joan Garcia como candidatos para ocupar su puesto, alcanzó además un récord histórico de los Mundiales. Con 519 minutos, superó a Walter Zenga, que con 517 minutos en Italia 1990 era hasta ahora el portero que más minutos sumó en los Mundiales con el cerrojo en su portería.
kept.relevance: This dated report supplies context on Simón retaining the starting role despite competition from Raya and García and distinguishes his scoreless-minutes record from the consecutive-clean-sheet record.

kept.excerpt: After helping Argentina to a Copa America triumph last year, Emiliano Martinez went one further by adding a global title to his list of international trophies. The stopper kept three clean sheets at Qatar 2022, as well as coming out victorious in two shoot-outs. Martinez played every minute of Argentina’s campaign and saved Kingsley Coman's spot-kick in the final shoot-out.
kept.relevance: The preceding tournament's Golden Glove profile provides historical evidence that championship success and decisive shoot-out performances matter alongside clean-sheet totals.

kept.excerpt: Belgium goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois has been awarded the Golden Glove award at the FIFA World Cup 2018 after guiding his team to third-place when they beat England on Saturday. The Chelsea keeper conceded six goals in Russia but made crucial saves to win this award after winners France keeper Hugo Lloris committed an embarrassing howler in the final.
kept.relevance: Courtois's award despite Belgium finishing third provides a historical counterexample to treating the champion's goalkeeper or the fewest goals conceded as an automatic winner.
